title: EvalMORAAL: Interpretable Chain-of-Thought and LLM-as-Judge Evaluation for Moral Alignment in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model moral judgments (via explicit Chain-of-Thought numerical scoring and implicit token-level log-probabilities) against country-level ground truth data from the World Values Survey (WVS) and PEW Global Attitudes Survey. The evaluation spans 64 countries and 23 moral topics to measure alignment gaps, specifically highlighting the performance disparity between Western and non-Western regions.
